title: The Shillong Commerce College (Taking-Over of Management) Act No.7 of 1984.
full_text: The Shillong Commerce College (Taking-Over of Management) Act No.7 of 1984. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19847 Act Number: 7 Enactment Date: 1984-11-17 Act Year: 1984 Short Title: The Shillong Commerce College (Taking-Over of Management) Act No.7 of 1984. Long Title: An Act to provide for the taking-over of the Management of the Shillong Commerce College within the State of Meghalaya from the present Governing Body and other committees of the College and holders of the offices of the College for a limited period in the public interest and in order to secure the proper management and control of the college. Ministry: Ministry of Law Department Department: Law Department Enforcement Date: 1984-05-14 Type: STATE Location: Meghalaya TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title extent and commencement Section 2. Definitions Section 3. Transfer of the management and control of the Commerce College and vesting thereof in the State Government. Section 4. Management of and control over the College and its affairs. Section 5. Preparation and submission of statements and penalty for non compliance. Section 6. Delivery of properties, Books of Accounts, Registers, etc., and penalty for non- compliance. Section 7. Creation of College Fund. Section 8. Relinquishment of management of the College or acquisition of the College. Section 9. Protection of action taken under the Act. Section 10. Power to make rules. Section 11. Over-riding effect of the Act. Section 12. Repeal of Ordinance 1 of 1984.
